# COMMON

> COMMON is the world's largest IBM technology professionals association, providing education, networking, and certification for IBM i, Power Systems, and enterprise technology professionals.

COMMON serves as a comprehensive hub for IBM i system administrators, developers, and IT professionals to access boot camp training, certifications, and community events. The organization hosts the annual POWERUp conference and maintains an extensive library of educational resources spanning system administration, programming, security, and database technologies.

## Key Topics

- IBM i
- ILE RPG
- Power Systems
- SQL/Db2
- Boot Camp Training
- System Administration
- IBM i Security
- Integrated File System (IFS)
- Certifications
- POWERUp Conference
- Professional Development
- User Community
- DevOps
- Networking
- Tech Education

## Boot Camp Training & Courses

- [Boot Camp Training Overview](https://www.common.org/boot-camp-training): COMMON boot camp training programs for IBM i, SQL, and IFS technologies
- [iBegin: IBM i Essentials](https://learn.common.org/products/ibegin-ibm-i-essentials): iBegin IBM i Essentials free boot camp course by Scott Klement
- [IBM i System Administration](https://www.common.org/boot-camp-training/ibm-i-system-administration): IBM i System Administration boot camp with video training on Power Systems
- [Programming in ILE RPG](https://www.common.org/boot-camp-training/programming-in-ile-rpg): ILE RPG programming boot camp with 10 video lessons by Scott Klement
- [IBM i Security Bootcamp](https://learn.common.org/products/ibm-i-security-bootcamp): IBM i Security boot camp with 9 video lessons sponsored by Fortra
- [IBM i Integrated File System (IFS) Bootcamp](https://learn.common.org/products/ibm-i-integrated-file-system-ifs-bootcamp): IBM i IFS boot camp covering file system and storage management
- [Getting Started with SQL on IBM i Bootcamp](https://learn.common.org/products/getting-started-with-sql-on-ibm-i-bootcamp): SQL on IBM i boot camp covering Db2 fundamentals and SQL DDL/DML
